statement: file_id=SRC-04;file_class=SOURCE;authority_level=2;governed_by=GOV-00;status=ACTIVE
violation: SRC-04 lacks the canonical FILE-META record or uses a non-ACTIVE status without higher-authority direction.
verification: Verify the first SRC-04 metadata record exactly matches the canonical metadata statement.

statement: SRC-04 owns idempotency semantics, replay determinism semantics, duplicate request behavior, and IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics.
violation: A generated source record routes SRC-04-owned idempotency, replay, duplicate request, or IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics to a file other than SRC-04.
verification: Check idempotency, replay, duplicate behavior, and IN_PROGRESS recovery records against SRC-INDEX responsibility routing.

statement: SRC-04 owns IDEMP-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines IDEMP-* semantics outside SRC-04.
verification: Validate IDEMP-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-04 is a SOURCE class governed file.
violation: SRC-04 is generated with any class other than SOURCE.
verification: Validate the class field of every SRC-04 record equals SOURCE.

statement: SRC-04 has authority_level 2.
violation: SRC-04 is generated with any authority_level other than 2.
verification: Validate the authority_level field of every SRC-04 record equals 2.

statement: SRC-04 must not define source truth owned by SRC-00, SRC-01, SRC-02, SRC-03, or SRC-05 through SRC-10.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines source truth routed to another SRC file by SRC-INDEX.
verification: Compare each SRC-04 statement against SRC-INDEX responsibility and namespace maps.

statement: SRC-04 owns idempotency semantics.
violation: Idempotency semantics are defined by a file other than SRC-04.
verification: Review generated source records for idempotency semantic definitions outside SRC-04.

statement: SRC-04 owns replay determinism semantics.
violation: Replay determinism semantics are defined by a file other than SRC-04.
verification: Review generated source records for replay determinism definitions outside SRC-04.

statement: SRC-04 owns duplicate request behavior.
violation: Duplicate request behavior is defined by a file other than SRC-04.
verification: Review generated source records for duplicate request behavior definitions outside SRC-04.

statement: SRC-04 owns IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics.
violation: IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics are defined by a file other than SRC-04.
verification: Review generated source records for IN_PROGRESS recovery definitions outside SRC-04.

statement: Idempotency exists to prevent duplicate balance effects.
violation: Duplicate requests are allowed to create duplicate balance effects.
verification: Review idempotency behavior for duplicate balance-effect prevention.

statement: Idempotency exists to prevent duplicate ledger entries.
violation: Duplicate requests are allowed to create duplicate ledger entries.
verification: Review idempotency behavior for duplicate ledger-entry prevention.

statement: Idempotency exists to return deterministic duplicate outcomes.
violation: Duplicate requests return nondeterministic or inconsistent outcomes.
verification: Review duplicate request behavior for deterministic outcome replay.

statement: Idempotency semantics must not be inferred from code, tests, README, UI, logs, or runtime behavior.
violation: Idempotency semantics are justified by code, tests, README, UI, logs, or runtime behavior instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review idempotency claims for trace to governed source authority instead of non-authority artifacts.

statement: The idempotency key must be derived from debitAuthorityPrincipal plus operationType plus requestId.
violation: An idempotency key is derived from a field set other than debitAuthorityPrincipal plus operationType plus requestId.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for exactly debitAuthorityPrincipal, operationType, and requestId inputs.

statement: For Gateway-mediated execution, debitAuthorityPrincipal is the Gateway-authenticated originalCallerPrincipal verified by Ledger Core, while caller identity verification remains owned by SRC-01.
violation: Gateway-mediated idempotency key derivation uses an unverified caller identity or SRC-04 redefines caller identity verification semantics.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for debitAuthorityPrincipal sourced from verified Gateway-authenticated originalCallerPrincipal.

statement: The idempotency key must not be requestId alone.
violation: An idempotency key is derived from requestId alone.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for rejection of requestId-only keys.

statement: The idempotency key must not use immediateCallerPrincipal alone when the immediate caller is Gateway.
violation: Gateway-mediated idempotency key derivation uses immediateCallerPrincipal alone.
verification: Review Gateway-mediated idempotency key derivation for exclusion of immediateCallerPrincipal-only keys.

statement: The same requestId from two different debitAuthorityPrincipals must produce different idempotency keys.
violation: The same requestId from two different debitAuthorityPrincipals produces the same idempotency key.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for debitAuthorityPrincipal separation.

statement: The same requestId from the same debitAuthorityPrincipal but different operationType must produce different idempotency keys.
violation: The same requestId from the same debitAuthorityPrincipal but different operationType produces the same idempotency key.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for operationType separation.

statement: Idempotency keys must be derived from canonical normalized values.
violation: An idempotency key is derived from non-canonical or non-normalized values.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for canonical normalized input values.

statement: Idempotency keys must not be derived from raw request strings.
violation: An idempotency key is derived from raw request strings.
verification: Review idempotency key derivation for exclusion of raw request string inputs.

statement: Amount equality for idempotency must compare canonical minor-unit values, while amount semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: Idempotency amount equality compares raw input strings or non-canonical amount representations, or SRC-04 redefines amount semantics.
verification: Review idempotency equality rules for canonical minor-unit amount comparison with amount semantics routed to SRC-02.

statement: Replay equality must compare canonical deterministic response serialization, while result serialization semantics remain owned by SRC-03.
violation: Replay equality compares non-canonical response content or SRC-04 redefines result serialization semantics.
verification: Review replay equality rules for canonical deterministic response serialization comparison with serialization semantics routed to SRC-03.

statement: IdempotencyRecord is the authoritative record for idempotency outcome tracking.
violation: A record other than IdempotencyRecord is treated as authoritative for idempotency outcome tracking.
verification: Review idempotency outcome tracking records for IdempotencyRecord authority.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has idempotencyKey.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks idempotencyKey.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for idempotencyKey.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has debitAuthorityPrincipal.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks debitAuthorityPrincipal.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for debitAuthorityPrincipal.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has immediateCallerPrincipal.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks immediateCallerPrincipal.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for immediateCallerPrincipal.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has operationType.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks operationType.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for operationType.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has requestId.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks requestId.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for requestId.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has status.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks status.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for status.

statement: IdempotencyRecord may have operationId.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.operationId is required for every idempotency record without source authority.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for optional operationId.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has responseHash.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks responseHash.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for responseHash.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has deterministicResponse.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks deterministicResponse.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for deterministicResponse.

statement: IdempotencyRecord has createdAt.
violation: IdempotencyRecord lacks createdAt.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for createdAt.

statement: IdempotencyRecord may have completedAt.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.completedAt is required for every idempotency record without source authority.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for optional completedAt.

statement: IdempotencyRecord may have recoveryState.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.recoveryState is required for every idempotency record without source authority.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field registry for optional recoveryState.

statement: IdempotencyRecord.status domain is COMMITTED, REJECTED, or IN_PROGRESS.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.status accepts a value outside COMMITTED, REJECTED, or IN_PROGRESS, or omits one of those values.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.status domain for exactly COMMITTED, REJECTED, and IN_PROGRESS.

statement: IdempotencyRecord.recoveryState domain is NONE, STALE_IN_PROGRESS, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED when recoveryState is present.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.recoveryState accepts a value outside NONE, STALE_IN_PROGRESS, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED when present.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.recoveryState domain for exactly NONE, STALE_IN_PROGRESS, and RECOVERY_REQUIRED when present.

statement: IdempotencyRecord.operationType must remain within the MVP operation type set defined upstream by SRC-02.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.operationType accepts a value outside the SRC-02 MVP operation type set.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.operationType domain for dependency on SRC-02 MVP operation type set.

statement: IdempotencyRecord must preserve debitAuthorityPrincipal distinctly from immediateCallerPrincipal.
violation: IdempotencyRecord collapses debitAuthorityPrincipal and immediateCallerPrincipal in Gateway-mediated execution.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord field semantics for distinct debitAuthorityPrincipal and immediateCallerPrincipal storage.

statement: IdempotencyRecord.deterministicResponse must be canonical and replay-stable when stored.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.deterministicResponse is non-canonical or changes across replay when stored.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.deterministicResponse storage for canonical replay-stable content.

statement: IdempotencyRecord.responseHash must correspond to canonical deterministic response content, while response hashing semantics remain owned by SRC-03.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.responseHash does not correspond to canonical deterministic response content or SRC-04 redefines response hashing semantics.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.responseHash for correspondence to canonical deterministic response content with hashing semantics routed to SRC-03.

statement: A duplicate request with prior COMMITTED idempotency outcome must return the same committed result.
violation: A duplicate request with prior COMMITTED idempotency outcome returns anything other than the same committed result.
verification: Review duplicate request behavior for same committed result replay after prior COMMITTED outcome.

statement: A duplicate request with prior REJECTED idempotency outcome must return the same rejected result.
violation: A duplicate request with prior REJECTED idempotency outcome returns anything other than the same rejected result.
verification: Review duplicate request behavior for same rejected result replay after prior REJECTED outcome.

statement: A duplicate request with prior IN_PROGRESS idempotency outcome must return a deterministic retry-safe response.
violation: A duplicate request with prior IN_PROGRESS idempotency outcome executes a new mutation or returns a nondeterministic response.
verification: Review duplicate request behavior for deterministic retry-safe response after prior IN_PROGRESS outcome.

statement: Duplicate requests must not create duplicate balance effects.
violation: A duplicate request creates an additional balance effect.
verification: Review duplicate execution behavior for no additional balance effects.

statement: Duplicate requests must not create duplicate ledger entries.
violation: A duplicate request creates additional ledger entries.
verification: Review duplicate execution behavior for no additional ledger entries.

statement: Duplicate requests must return the same deterministic outcome for the same idempotency key.
violation: Duplicate requests return different deterministic outcomes for the same idempotency key.
verification: Review duplicate request behavior for deterministic outcome equality by idempotency key.

statement: Duplicate replay must not execute a new authoritative balance mutation.
violation: Duplicate replay executes a new authoritative balance mutation.
verification: Review replay path for absence of new authoritative balance mutation.

statement: Duplicate replay must not append new authoritative ledger entries.
violation: Duplicate replay appends new authoritative ledger entries.
verification: Review replay path for absence of new authoritative ledger entry append.

statement: Duplicate replay must not replace the original deterministic response with a replay-time response.
violation: Duplicate replay replaces original deterministic response content with replay-time response content.
verification: Review replay path for preservation of original deterministic response.

statement: Duplicate IN_PROGRESS response body must be canonical and replay-stable.
violation: Duplicate IN_PROGRESS response body is non-canonical or changes across retry.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS duplicate response body for canonical replay-stable content.

statement: If authoritative commit succeeds, idempotency status must become COMMITTED.
violation: Authoritative commit succeeds but idempotency status does not become COMMITTED.
verification: Review commit outcome storage for COMMITTED idempotency status after authoritative commit success.

statement: If deterministic validation fails, idempotency status should become REJECTED.
violation: Deterministic validation failure is not stored as REJECTED without explicit justification or source-defined exception.
verification: Review deterministic validation failure handling for REJECTED idempotency outcome storage where applicable.

statement: Rejected requests should be stored as deterministic idempotency outcomes when rejection reason is deterministic.
violation: A request with deterministic rejection reason is not stored as a deterministic idempotency outcome without explicit justification or source-defined exception.
verification: Review rejected request handling for deterministic idempotency outcome storage when rejection reason is deterministic.

statement: Nondeterministic system failures must not be falsely stored as final business rejections.
violation: A nondeterministic system failure is stored as a final business rejection.
verification: Review idempotency outcome storage for exclusion of nondeterministic system failures as final business rejections.

statement: System/internal failures before deterministic business rejection must not be stored as final rejected business outcomes unless explicitly classified as deterministic by the owning failure or result sources.
violation: A system or internal failure before deterministic business rejection is stored as a final rejected business outcome without deterministic classification by the owning sources.
verification: Review idempotency outcome storage for deterministic classification dependency before final rejected business outcome storage.

statement: If Ledger Core traps before authoritative commit, the system must not persist a COMMITTED idempotency outcome.
violation: A COMMITTED idempotency outcome is persisted after Ledger Core traps before authoritative commit.
verification: Review trap-before-commit handling for absence of COMMITTED idempotency persistence.

statement: IN_PROGRESS records must not be treated as COMMITTED.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS record is treated as COMMITTED.
verification: Review idempotency status handling for separation of IN_PROGRESS and COMMITTED.

statement: IN_PROGRESS records must not create duplicate balance effects.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS idempotency record permits duplicate balance effects.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS duplicate handling for no duplicate balance effects.

statement: IN_PROGRESS records must not create duplicate ledger entries.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS idempotency record permits duplicate ledger entries.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS duplicate handling for no duplicate ledger entries.

statement: IN_PROGRESS outcomes must have a deterministic recovery policy.
violation: IN_PROGRESS outcomes lack deterministic recovery policy.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS recovery records for deterministic recovery policy.

statement: Idempotency lookup must occur before any new balance mutation is attempted.
violation: A new balance mutation is attempted before idempotency lookup.
verification: Review mutation path ordering for idempotency lookup before balance mutation attempt.

statement: Idempotency lookup must occur before any new ledger entry append is attempted.
violation: A new ledger entry append is attempted before idempotency lookup.
verification: Review mutation path ordering for idempotency lookup before ledger entry append attempt.

statement: A mutation path that bypasses idempotency control is invalid, while forbidden API semantics remain owned by SRC-09.
violation: A balance-affecting mutation path bypasses idempotency control or SRC-04 defines forbidden API semantics.
verification: Review balance-affecting mutation paths for idempotency control before mutation with forbidden API semantics routed to SRC-09.

statement: Duplicate detection must precede authoritative commit attempt.
violation: An authoritative commit attempt begins before duplicate detection.
verification: Review commit ordering for duplicate detection before authoritative commit attempt.

statement: Absence of a prior idempotency record is not proof that duplicate effects are impossible unless checked under the authorized idempotency path.
violation: The system treats absence of a prior idempotency record outside the authorized idempotency path as proof duplicate effects are impossible.
verification: Review duplicate detection claims for authorized idempotency path checks.

statement: Idempotency control must not be bypassed for Transfer execution.
violation: Transfer execution bypasses idempotency control.
verification: Review Transfer execution path for required idempotency control.

statement: Stale IN_PROGRESS records must resolve only through a source-defined recovery path.
violation: A stale IN_PROGRESS record resolves through an ad hoc or non-source-defined recovery path.
verification: Review stale IN_PROGRESS recovery for source-defined recovery path.

statement: Unresolved stale IN_PROGRESS records must put the affected idempotency key into retry-safe recovery state.
violation: An unresolved stale IN_PROGRESS record does not put the affected idempotency key into retry-safe recovery state.
verification: Review stale IN_PROGRESS handling for retry-safe recovery state on affected idempotency key.

statement: Unresolved stale IN_PROGRESS records must not allow duplicate balance effects.
violation: An unresolved stale IN_PROGRESS record permits duplicate balance effects.
verification: Review stale IN_PROGRESS handling for duplicate balance-effect prevention.

statement: An IN_PROGRESS record must not be converted to COMMITTED unless the corresponding authoritative Operation exists.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS record is converted to COMMITTED without corresponding authoritative Operation existence.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS recovery for corresponding authoritative Operation existence before COMMITTED conversion.

statement: An IN_PROGRESS record must not be converted to COMMITTED unless the required authoritative LedgerEntry records exist.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS record is converted to COMMITTED without required authoritative LedgerEntry records.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS recovery for required authoritative LedgerEntry existence before COMMITTED conversion.

statement: An IN_PROGRESS record may be converted to deterministic REJECTED only if source-defined recovery proves no authoritative commit occurred.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS record is converted to deterministic REJECTED without source-defined proof that no authoritative commit occurred.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS recovery for proof no authoritative commit occurred before deterministic REJECTED conversion.

statement: An IN_PROGRESS record may be converted to deterministic REJECTED only if the rejection class is deterministic.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS record is converted to REJECTED using a nondeterministic rejection class.
verification: Review IN_PROGRESS recovery for deterministic rejection class requirement before REJECTED conversion.

statement: Recovery must not infer COMMITTED status from partial or derived state.
violation: Recovery infers COMMITTED status from partial state or derived state.
verification: Review recovery rules for COMMITTED conversion based only on authoritative Operation and required LedgerEntry existence.

statement: Recovery must not use Read Model projection state as proof of authoritative commit.
violation: Recovery uses Read Model projection state as proof of authoritative commit.
verification: Review recovery rules for exclusion of Read Model projection state as authoritative commit proof.

statement: Recovery state must be inspectable when an idempotency key is blocked by stale IN_PROGRESS status.
violation: An idempotency key blocked by stale IN_PROGRESS status has no inspectable recovery state.
verification: Review stale IN_PROGRESS recovery for inspectable recovery state.

statement: Idempotency outcomes must survive Ledger Core canister upgrade.
violation: Idempotency outcomes are lost across Ledger Core canister upgrade.
verification: Review upgrade durability requirements for idempotency outcome preservation with stable-state mechanics routed to SRC-08.

statement: COMMITTED idempotency outcomes must be preserved across upgrade.
violation: COMMITTED idempotency outcomes are lost, rewritten, or weakened across upgrade.
verification: Review upgrade durability requirements for COMMITTED idempotency outcome preservation.

statement: Deterministic REJECTED idempotency outcomes must be preserved across upgrade.
violation: Deterministic REJECTED idempotency outcomes are lost, rewritten, or weakened across upgrade.
verification: Review upgrade durability requirements for deterministic REJECTED idempotency outcome preservation.

statement: Upgrade recovery must preserve COMMITTED and deterministic REJECTED idempotency outcomes before attempting any IN_PROGRESS repair.
violation: Upgrade recovery attempts IN_PROGRESS repair before preserving COMMITTED and deterministic REJECTED idempotency outcomes.
verification: Review upgrade recovery ordering for preservation of terminal deterministic idempotency outcomes before IN_PROGRESS repair.

statement: Idempotency recovery must not create duplicate effects after upgrade.
violation: Idempotency recovery creates duplicate balance effects after upgrade.
verification: Review post-upgrade idempotency recovery for duplicate-effect prevention.

statement: Idempotency recovery must not lose deterministic replay outcomes after upgrade.
violation: Idempotency recovery loses deterministic replay outcomes after upgrade.
verification: Review post-upgrade idempotency recovery for preservation of deterministic replay outcomes.

statement: Stable-state and migration mechanics remain owned by SRC-08.
violation: SRC-04 defines stable-state or migration mechanics.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for upgrade durability references only, with stable-state and migration mechanics routed to SRC-08.

statement: Idempotency replay equality must compare canonical deterministic response serialization.
violation: Idempotency replay equality compares anything other than canonical deterministic response serialization.
verification: Review replay equality rules for canonical deterministic response serialization comparison.

statement: Idempotency replay equality must not compare non-canonical runtime object representations.
violation: Idempotency replay equality compares non-canonical runtime object representations.
verification: Review replay equality rules for exclusion of runtime object representation comparison.

statement: Idempotency replay equality must not depend on language object iteration order.
violation: Idempotency replay equality depends on language object iteration order.
verification: Review replay equality rules for independence from language object iteration order.

statement: Committed replay must return the original deterministic committed response.
violation: Committed replay returns anything other than the original deterministic committed response.
verification: Review committed replay behavior for original deterministic committed response return.

statement: Deterministic rejected replay must return the original deterministic rejected response.
violation: Deterministic rejected replay returns anything other than the original deterministic rejected response.
verification: Review rejected replay behavior for original deterministic rejected response return.

statement: Committed replay must preserve the original canonical commit timestamp through the result contract owned by SRC-03.
violation: Committed replay omits or replaces the original canonical commit timestamp, or SRC-04 redefines result timestamp semantics.
verification: Review committed replay behavior for original canonical commit timestamp preservation through SRC-03 result contract.

statement: Replay equality must not replace original committed content with replay-time content.
violation: Replay equality replaces original committed content with replay-time content.
verification: Review replay equality behavior for preservation of original committed content.

statement: Replay equality must fail validation if the same idempotency key can serialize to different deterministic responses.
violation: The same idempotency key can serialize to different deterministic responses without validation failure.
verification: Review replay equality validation for failure when one idempotency key maps to different deterministic serialized responses.

statement: SRC-04 must not define project identity semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines project identity semantics instead of referencing SRC-00.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for project identity definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define canister authority or caller identity semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines canister authority or caller identity semantics instead of referencing SRC-01.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for canister authority or caller identity definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define Account, Asset, Balance, Amount, or Operation record entity semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines Account, Asset, Balance, Amount, or Operation record entity semantics instead of referencing SRC-02.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for Account, Asset, Balance, Amount, or Operation record entity definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define Transfer validation, lifecycle transition, or result contract semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines Transfer validation, lifecycle transition, or result contract semantics instead of referencing SRC-03.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for Transfer validation, lifecycle transition, or result contract definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define detailed ledger-entry, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines detailed ledger-entry, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity semantics instead of referencing SRC-05.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for detailed ledger-entry, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define failure-class semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines failure-class semantics instead of referencing SRC-06.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for failure-class definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define Read Model derivation semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, or rebuild semantics instead of referencing SRC-07.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for Read Model derivation definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define upgrade or stable-state mechanics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines upgrade or stable-state mechanics instead of referencing SRC-08.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for upgrade or stable-state mechanics definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define API or forbidden behavior records.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines API or forbidden behavior records instead of referencing SRC-09.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for API or forbidden behavior definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not define test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics.
violation: A SRC-04 record defines test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics instead of referencing SRC-10.
verification: Review SRC-04 records for test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier definitions.

statement: SRC-04 must not include implementation guidance.
violation: A SRC-04 record includes implementation guidance, build procedure, codegen procedure, framework workflow, or target-file instructions.
verification: Search SRC-04 statements for implementation guidance or build workflow terms.

statement: Idempotency claims must not be inferred from code.
violation: An idempotency claim is justified by code behavior instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for code-derived idempotency claims.

statement: Idempotency claims must not be inferred from tests.
violation: An idempotency claim is justified by test output instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for test-derived idempotency claims.

statement: Idempotency claims must not be inferred from README content.
violation: An idempotency claim is justified by README content instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for README-derived idempotency claims.

statement: Idempotency claims must not be inferred from chat history.
violation: An idempotency claim is justified by chat history instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for chat-derived idempotency claims.

statement: Replay determinism claims must trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
violation: A replay determinism claim lacks trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for replay determinism claims after full-file collection.

statement: Duplicate behavior claims must trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
violation: A duplicate behavior claim lacks trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for duplicate behavior claims after full-file collection.

statement: IN_PROGRESS recovery claims must trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
violation: An IN_PROGRESS recovery claim lacks trace to GOV-00, SRC-INDEX, upstream SRC files where relevant, or SRC-04 records after generation.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for IN_PROGRESS recovery claims after full-file collection.
